title: Random-Shooting MPC over a Learned Dynamics Model is Sample-Efficient on Pendulum Swing-Up
abstract: We show that a two-layer MLP dynamics model trained on 2000 uniformly-random transitions from Pendulum-v1 is sufficient for random-shooting receding-horizon model predictive control to reach a mean episode return of -210 over 5 evaluation episodes. This is a SYNTHETIC paper shipped as a repro-agent fixture; it describes no real experiment by any real author.
